title: Struct-literal oracle is stronger than hand-crafted JSON literal
description: Using kith_core::Message{..} as the oracle is strictly stronger than hand-writing the JSON. The struct literal is exhaustive by Rust's type system: if Message gains a new required field, the test fails to compile rather than silently diverging. The serde rename attribute (the actual oracle) is the sole source of truth for the wire name, and the kith-core field-name test independently pins it. A future contributor might suggest 'simplifying' back to a raw JSON literal — resist this: the raw literal would re-introduce a self-oracle risk (the test author picks the key name) and would lose the compile-time exhaustiveness guard.
